title: Per-axle fields display and respond to touch on a phone
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. A phone; an inspection with a per-axle field (seed a template with a Per axle field); gloves available for the touch check.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the per-axle field renders one card per measurement row and does not scroll sideways at any width.
2. Confirm every tap target is large enough for a gloved thumb, including the unit selector and the Drum, Disc, Single and Dual controls.
3. Confirm value inputs do not zoom the page when they take focus.
4. Confirm moving between axles happens from a header rather than by scrolling, and the primary action advances to the next axle.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The per-axle field renders one card per measurement row and does not scroll sideways at any width.
  • Every target a technician taps is large enough to hit with a gloved thumb, including the unit selector and the Drum, Disc, Single and Dual controls.
  • Value inputs do not zoom the page when they take focus.
  • Moving between axles happens from a header rather than by scrolling, and the primary action advances to the next axle.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9397 (S14 — Inspection filling on a phone); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S14; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S14-R1: “The per-axle field will render one card per measurement row and will not scroll sideways at any width”
  • S14-R2: “Every target a technician taps will be large enough to hit with a gloved thumb, including the unit selector and the Drum, Disc, Single and Dual controls”
  • S14-R3: “Value inputs will not zoom the page when they take focus”
  • S14-R4: “Moving between axles will happen from a header rather than by scrolling, and the primary action will advance to the next axle”
